faqs.a:
Telephone service suppliers providing telephone service in the city are hereby authorized
               to collect the emergency telephone charge imposed by section 34-31 in accordance with
               C.R.S. § 29-11-101 et seq., as amended. The board of the Jefferson County Emergency
               Telephone Authority is hereby authorized to direct the telephone service suppliers
               to commence collecting the emergency telephone charge by November 1, 1984.
(Code 1981, § 2-195; Ord. No. 2116, § 1, 10-15-1984)
